official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Sandy Music Lab is a set of music tools for guitarists, singers and songwriters. It helps you play, practice and write songs by doing the music theory math for you. Ask it to:

- transpose a chord sheet to a new key (lyrics stay untouched)
- work out capo shapes
- name a chord from the frets you're holding
- show one of 190 chord charts
- convert to Nashville numbers
- find the best key for a singer or congregation
- size a pedalboard power supply
- get delay times for any tempo
- pick string gauges for drop tunings
- build a song style prompt for music generators

Every answer links to the matching interactive tool on sandymusiclab.com. It's read-only, has no ads in the app, and needs no account.
